sentiment.instructions: Which emotional tone dominates this text?

criteria.positive: Pleasant emotions such as joy, amusement, love, pride or relief dominate the text, or the author approves of something.
criteria.neutral: No emotion dominates, and the tone is calm, matter-of-fact or impersonal.
criteria.negative: Unpleasant emotions such as anger, sadness, fear, disgust or frustration dominate the text, or the author disapproves of something.
